signature: SUBROUTINE DPFTRS( TRANSR, UPLO, N, NRHS, A, B, LDB, INFO )

params.name: transr
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: The Normal `TRANSR` of RFP A is stored;
-   `= 'T'`: The Transpose `TRANSR` of RFP A is stored.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of RFP A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of RFP A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: The triangular factor U or L from the Cholesky factorization of RFP $A = U^T \, U$ or RFP $A = L \, L^T$, as computed by DPFTRF. See note below for more details about RFP A.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the right hand side matrix B. On exit, the solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
